name: Calming the Wind and Waves (Định Phong Ba)
story: The founder's staff and cape, named for the song the guides sing on the road: bamboo staff and straw sandals, lighter than a horse; who is afraid? One straw cape in the misty rain, and let it be all my life. Nhậm Bình Sinh split them in 1169, the staff to the head and the cape to the Road Mother. The Gate reads the split as a division. Phí Thoa Y reads it as a balance. The set is whole only in one pair of hands.

name: Son of Thủ Lôi Bảo (Lôi Bảo Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: each time you evade, your next staff strike deals 30 % of its damage as Lightning and cannot be blocked.

story: His father's jacket and his brother's token: the fort that burned and the pass that was lost. He wears them beside the founder's staff, which is half of Calming the Wind and Waves and whole only when the cape comes back to it.

name: The Lamp and the Road (Đăng Lộ Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Lamp Does Not Go Out (Đăng Bất Diệt)
bonuses.rule: each hit you evade keeps the lamp lit for 3 more seconds, and while it is lit you regenerate 1 % of your health each second. Below a quarter of your health the lamp lights itself, and the regeneration doubles.

story: Her lamp and her beads, the Road Mother's own. She wears them beside the founder's straw cape, which is half of Calming the Wind and Waves. The guides say a Road Mother needs only these two. The founder's pair is a head's business.
